open_arms_for_prop: open left and right robot arms to leave a specified gap around a prop in MuJoCo physics
create_arm_prop_contact_remover: create an ArmPropContactRemover instance to remove contacts between a robot arm and a prop via inverse kinematics
remove_contacts: remove all contacts between a robot arm and a prop by iteratively adjusting joint positions using IK
review_open_arms_for_prop: review the open_arms_for_prop function that opens both arms away from a prop with a configurable gap
refactor_arm_prop_contact_remover: refactor the ArmPropContactRemover class to support custom joint limit tolerance or IK correction weight parameters
